claims.claim_text: Boeing completed the acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems Holdings, Inc. on December 8, 2025 by exchanging approximately $4.7 billion of Boeing shares; Spirit employs approximately 15,000 people. Also completed Q4 2025 divestiture of portions of Digital Aviation Solutions business for $10.55 billion all-cash.
claims.subject: The Boeing Company
claims.predicate: completed Spirit AeroSystems acquisition and Digital Aviation Solutions divestiture
claims.object_value: $4.7B stock for Spirit + $10.55B cash for DAS
claims.source_quote: On December 8, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems Holdings, Inc. (Spirit) by exchanging approximately $4.7 billion of Boeing shares ... On October 31, 2025, we completed the divestiture of portions of our BGS segment s Digital Aviation Solutions business (Digital Aviation Solutions Divestiture) for $10.55 billion

kwargs.parent_thesis: Vertically integrate 737/767/777/787 fuselage and structural supply chain by acquiring sole-source supplier Spirit AeroSystems, while divesting non-core Digital Aviation Solutions to focus on core aerospace platforms.

acquisitions.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings, Inc.
acquisitions.rationale: Reacquire fuselage and structural supplier to control 737 quality system after 737-9 door plug accident

claims.claim_text: Boeing raised $18.2B from common stock issuance and $5.7B from Mandatory convertible preferred stock issuance in Q4 2024, net of issuance costs (~$23.9B total equity raise).
claims.subject: The Boeing Company
claims.source_quote: Net cash provided during 2024 was primarily driven by the issuance of common stock and Mandatory convertible preferred stock in the fourth quarter of 2024, which resulted in cash proceeds of $18.2 billion and $5.7 billion, net of issuance costs.
